items.q: Do you handle both design and development?
items.a: Yes. Design and development are one job here, so the site is designed to be fast and simple to build, and shown in stages you can see and stop.

items.q: Can you redesign my existing website?
items.a: Yes. We start by checking what works and what holds the site back, then rebuild or fix it in stages.

items.q: Will my website work well on phones?
items.a: Yes. We build for mobile first and measure speed on a mid-range phone over mobile data.

items.q: Is there a lock-in or a long contract?
items.a: No lock-in beyond the notice period, and you get proper GST invoices.
